<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Analyze the board structure
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find black objects and their positions
black_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'B']
print(f"Black objects: {len(black_nodes)}")

# Group by size
from collections import Counter
sizes = Counter(n['pixels'] for n in black_nodes)
print(f"Black object sizes: {dict(sizes)}")

# Find large black objects (potential gaps)
large_black = [n for n in black_nodes if n['pixels'] > 10]
print(f"\nLarge black objects (>10 pixels): {len(large_black)}")
for n in large_black[:10]:
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    print(f"  pixels={n['pixels']}, row {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, col {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}, boundary={n['boundary'][:6]}")

# Check sky blue objects
sky_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"\nSky blue objects: {len(sky_nodes)}")
for n in sky_nodes:
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    print(f"  pixels={n['pixels']}, row {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, col {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Try clicking on a black gap
print("\n--- Trying to click on black gap ---")
if large_black:
    # Click on the first large black object
    n = large_black[0]
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    print(f"Clicking at row={center_r}, col={center_c}")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    color_pixels = {}
    for n in nodes:
        c = n['color']
        color_pixels[c] = color_pixels.get(c, 0) + n['pixels']
    print(f"After click: W={color_pixels.get('W',0)}, p={color_pixels.get('p',0)}, S={color_pixels.get('S',0)}, B={color_pixels.get('B',0)}")
    print(f"Game over: {result.get('game_over', False)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
